name: how not to slide up a clone
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Clone 0: 2 cells, starting at (0, 3, 1) through (0, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Yellow clone slope.

Tick 1: Clone 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
